remarks: Charming Ranch in Westport's coveted Old Hill neighborhood! Discover the potential in this classic 1966 ranch-style home, offering 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, and 1.67 acres of serene and dry private land. With great bones, this well-loved home presents a fantastic renovation opportunity to restore its mid-century appeal or customize it to fit your vision. The expansive lot also provides the perfect setting to build new and create your dream home in a tranquil and beautiful hilltop setting. Whether you're looking to invest, renovate, or start fresh, this unique property is full of exciting possibilities! Don't miss this rare chance to own in a sought-after location, just minutes away from downtown, train, highways, beach, YMCA, and Earthplace.
